Session card layouts

Option A's faded map panel, unchanged, with six text layouts. Hierarchy: location name first, everything else second. Badges removed; dates shortened in a few different ways. Fonts are only Sofia Sans Condensed and SF. Each layout shows a card at maximum content (long name + track) above an ordinary one.

1. Sofia hero, quiet linesName in Sofia Bold 22. Date, then duration · distance as two quiet SF lines. Track line in accent. Date: “Today · 1:32 PM”.
